commit.message: Optimize native scanner and convergent call graph without changing qualification caps

source_readbacks.text:
"""Author the fixed HIA Core bootstrap compiler; never used after B0.

The Python AST lowering here is a development-time source authoring aid.  The
checked-in HIA assembly contains the scanner, semantic verifier and x86 emitter.
B1 and subsequent generations consume that assembly as bytes themselves.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import ast
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
from hepta.hia_agent_assembly import render_assembly
from tools.hia_selfhost_limits import MAX_INSTRUCTIONS, MAX_CORE_NODES, MAX_RELOCATIONS
from tools.hia_selfhost_owned_elf import SOURCE as OWNED_ELF_SOURCE
from tools.hia_selfhost_chain_elf import SOURCE as CHAIN_ELF_SOURCE
from tools.hia_selfhost_effects import source as effect_source
from tools.hia_selfhost_multi_results import SOURCE as MULTI_RESULT_SOURCE
from tools.hia_selfhost_keywords import keyword_source
from tools.hia_selfhost_signed import SOURCE as SIGNED_SOURCE
from tools.hia_selfhost_traps import SOURCE as TRAP_SOURCE
from tools.hia_selfhost_returned_loans import SOURCE as RETURNED_LOAN_SOURCE
from tools.hia_selfhost_cli import SOURCE as CLI_SOURCE
from tools.hia_selfhost_names import SOURCE as NAMES_SOURCE
from tools.hia_selfhost_exports import SOURCE as EXPORTS_SOURCE

TYPES = {"u64": 1, "usize": 2, "u32": 3, "u8": 4, "bool": 5, "readbuf": 6, "mutbuf": 7, "buffer": 8, "chain": 9, "u16": 10, "i64": 11, "isize": 12, "i32": 13, "i8": 14, "i16": 15, "unit": 16}
WORDS = ["hia-asm.v1", "hepta.hia.program.v8", "selfhost", "fn", "effects", "read", "write", "trap", "entry", "block", "end", "ret", "jump", "branch", "value", "mode", "wrap", "function", "true", "false", *TYPES,
 "const", "int.add.wrap", "int.sub.wrap", "int.mul.wrap", "bit.and", "bit.or", "bit.xor", "int.shl.checked", "int.shr.checked", "compare.eq", "compare.ne", "compare.lt", "compare.le", "compare.gt", "compare.ge", "bool.and", "bool.or", "bool.not", "int.cast", "buffer.len", "buffer.load", "buffer.store", "call", "selfhost_elf", "buffer.swap", "bit.not", "int.add.checked", "int.sub.checked", "select", "int.mul.checked", "int.div.checked", "int.rem.checked", "int.neg.checked", "buffer.fill", "buffer.fill_range", "buffer.copy", "buffer.copy_range", "buffer.move_within", "borrow.read", "borrow.mut", "loan.end"]
WORDS += ["alloc", "buffer.new", "buffer.try_new", "owner.move", "owner.drop"]
WORDS += ["chain.empty", "chain.try_push", "chain.pop", "chain.is_empty", "chain.head_read", "chain.head_mut"]
WORDS += ["checked", "null"]
WORDS += ["allocation", "bounds", "division_by_zero", "overflow", "user"]
WORDS += ["return_loans", "selfhost_exec", "exports"]
W = {s: i + 300 for i,s in enumerate(WORDS)}
# Scratch ABI: state 0..2047; function records; block records; local SSA types;
# argument vector; relative relocation records; bounded call graph and marks.
# All are ordinary borrowed bytes. The graph occupies previously unused scratch
# after the complete relocation table, so this profile keeps the 1 MiB limit.
FBASE, FSTRIDE, BBASE, BSTRIDE, VBASE, ARGS, FIXBASE = 4096, 320, 45056, 320, 536576, 569344, 570368
CBASE, CSTATE = 858368, 874752
# The existing block record has sixteen trailing bytes. Each parameter's
# resource graph fits root-index | parent-index << 4; self/self is external.
# Current-block capability records use previously unused workspace. No public
# source, output, workspace, block or SSA ceiling changes.
CAPBASE, KBASE, CAPTMP, QBASE = 875776, 924928, 926464, 926480
# One-byte original formal identities; 0 means no external borrowed origin.
# Separate from block identity and resource parent/root, including at CFG joins.
ORIGINBASE, BLOCKORIGIN = 928528, 930576
# BLOCKORIGIN ends at 955152; a per-function 2048-slot exact-name table
# occupies [955152, 1004304); the 256-entry block-name map occupies
# [1004304, 1010448), still within the unchanged 1 MiB workspace.
SOURCE = r'''
def compile(s:readbuf, o:mutbuf, w:mutbuf) -> u32:
    phase = 0
    n = length(w)
    if n < 1048576:
        return 4294967294
    if length(s) > 1048576:
        return 4294967295
    if length(o) > 1048576:
        return 4294967294
    fill_range(w, CBASE, 17408, 0)
    fill_range(w, KBASE, 1536, 0)
    put(w, 432, 1)
    while phase < 3:
        fill_range(w, 0, 256, 0)
        put(w, 248, 4)
        put(w, 264, 0)
        put(w, 272, 0)
        put(w, 344, 0)
        put(w, 360, 0)
        put(w, 368, 0)
        put(w, 48, phase)
        next_token(s, w)
        expect(s, w, @hia-asm.v1@)
        expect(s, w, @hepta.hia.program.v8@)
        if get(w, 32) != 0:
            fail(w, 67)
        identifier(s, w)
        if get(w, 8) == @selfhost_elf@:
            put(w, 232, 1)
            expect(s, w, @selfhost_elf@)
        else:
            if get(w, 8) == @selfhost_exec@:
                put(w, 232, 2)
                expect(s, w, @selfhost_exec@)
            else:
                # A module identifier is a Core label, not a source dispatch
                # key. Only the two explicit historical output profiles above
                # select a different ABI; all other admitted names emit flat.
                next_token(s, w)
        expect(s, w, 10)
        read_exports(s, w)
        if get(w, 232) == 1:
            elf_begin(o, w)
        if get(w, 232) == 2:
            cli_begin(o, w)
        if get(w, 640) == 0:
            wrapper(o, w)
        put(w, 240, get(w, 56))
        while get(w, 8) == @fn@ and get(w, 40) == 0:
            parse_function(s, o, w)
        expect(s, w, 0)
        if get(w, 64) == 0:
            fail(w, 1)
        if get(w, 40) != 0:
            return 4294967295
        if phase == 0:
            put(w, 1024, get(w, 64))
            if get(w, 432) == 0:
                check_calls(w)
                if get(w, 40) != 0:
                    return 4294967295
        validate_exports(s, w)
        if get(w, 40) != 0:
            return 4294967295
        if get(w, 232) == 1:
            chain_drop_helper(o, w)
            if get(w, 640) == 1:
                exports_finish(s, o, w)
            else:
                elf_finish(o, w)
        if get(w, 232) == 2:
            cli_finish(o, w)
        if phase == 1:
            if get(w, 56) > length(o):
                return 4294967294
        if phase == 0 and get(w, 432) == 1:
            put(w, 432, 0)
        else:
            phase = phase + 1
    fix_all(o, w)
    if get(w, 40) != 0:
        return 4294967295
    return get(w, 56)

def parse_function(s:readbuf, o:mutbuf, w:mutbuf) -> u64:
    expect(s, w, @fn@)
    separated(w)
    if get(w, 32) != 0:
        fail(w, 49)
    f = read_function_name(s, w, 1)
    adjacent(w)
    if f != get(w, 64) or f >= 128:
        return fail(w, 2)
    put(w, 72, f)
    put(w, 64, f + 1)
    put(w, 384, 0)
    put(w, 392, 0)
    fb = FBASE + f * FSTRIDE
    if get(w, 48) == 0:
        put(w, fb + 8, get(w, 80))
        put(w, fb + 40, 0)
    put(w, 480, 0)
    # Both tables are private to the current function. A name record is
    # vacant when its size is zero; define() writes both SSA type and block
    # origin before they can become live. Clearing their complete extents is
    # equivalent to the former 2048 strided vacancy/type resets and lets the
    # ordinary checked bulk operation emit two REP STOSB sequences.
    fill_range(w, 955152, 49152, 0)
    fill_range(w, VBASE, 32768, 0)
    count = parse_params(s, w, 1)
    if get(w, 40) != 0:
        return 0
    account_nodes(w, 7 + count * 3)
    expect(s, w, 45)
    adjacent(w)
    expect(s, w, 62)
    expect(s, w, 40)
    rt = read_result_types(s, w)
    if get(w, 48) == 0:
        put(w, fb + 24, count)
        put(w, fb + 32, rt)
    separated(w)
    expect(s, w, @effects@)
    adjacent(w)
    expect(s, w, 40)
    effects = parse_effects(s, w)
    if get(w, 48) == 0:
        put(w, fb + 176, effects)
    separated(w)
    expect(s, w, @entry@)
    adjacent(w)
    expect(s, w, 40)
    adjacent(w)
    discover_blocks(s, w)
    entry_block = expect(s, w, 258)
    if get(w, 48) == 0:
        put(w, fb + 264, entry_block)
    else:
        if entry_block != get(w, fb + 264):
            fail(w, 4)
    adjacent(w)
    expect(s, w, 41)
    read_return_loans(s, w)
    expect(s, w, 10)
    if f == 0 and get(w, 640) == 0:
        if count != 3 or rt != 3 or get(w, fb + 184) != 1:
            fail(w, 5)
        if get(w, fb + 48) != 6 or get(w, fb + 56) != 7 or get(w, fb + 64) != 7:
            fail(w, 5)
    put(w, 96, 0)
    function_start(o, w)
    while get(w, 8) == @block@ and get(w, 40) == 0:
        parse_block(s, o, w)
    expect(s, w, @end@)
    expect(s, w, 10)
    if get(w, 96) == 0:
        fail(w, 6)
    if get(w, 48) == 0:
        put(w, fb + 16, get(w, 96))
        if get(w, 40) == 0 and get(w, 432) == 0:
            check_graph(s, o, w)
    return 0

def parse_params(s:readbuf, w:mutbuf, signature:u64) -> u64:
    expect(s, w, 40)
    count = 0
    v = 0
    t = 0
    base = FBASE + get(w, 72) * FSTRIDE
    while get(w, 8) != 41 and get(w, 40) == 0:
        v = expect(s, w, 256)
        expect(s, w, 58)
        t = read_type(s, w)
        if count >= 16:
            return fail(w, 7)
        if signature == 1:
            if v != count:
                fail(w, 8)
            if get(w, 48) == 0:
                put(w, base + 48 + count * 8, t)
        else:
            define(w, v, t)
            if get(w, 40) != 0:
                return 0
            if get(w, 48) == 0:
                put(w, BBASE + get(w, 88) * BSTRIDE + 32 + count * 16, v)
                put(w, BBASE + get(w, 88) * BSTRIDE + 40 + count * 16, t)
            if get(w, 96) == get(w, base + 264):
                if v != count or t != get(w, base + 48 + count * 8):
                    fail(w, 9)
        count = count + 1
        if get(w, 8) != 41:
            expect(s, w, 44)
            if get(w, 8) == 41:
                fail(w, 10)
    expect(s, w, 41)
    return count

def parse_block(s:readbuf, o:mutbuf, w:mutbuf) -> u64:
    # This block-local pending result is separate from the v5 node counter at
    # 248. A self call is admitted only when the next token is its exact ret.
    put(w, 256, 0)
    source_at = get(w, 24)
    expect(s, w, @block@)
    separated(w)
    b = expect(s, w, 258)
    adjacent(w)
    if b != get(w, 96) or b >= 256 or get(w, 80) >= 1536:
        return fail(w, 11)
    put(w, 88, get(w, 80))
    put(w, 80, get(w, 80) + 1)
    bb = BBASE + get(w, 88) * BSTRIDE
    if get(w, 48) == 0:
        put(w, bb, source_at)
        put(w, bb + 16, get(w, 72))
        put(w, bb + 24, 0)
        put(w, bb + 288, 18446744073709551615)
        put(w, bb + 296, 18446744073709551615)
    if get(w, 48) > 0:
        put(w, bb, get(w, 56))
    count = parse_params(s, w, 0)
    account_nodes(w, 4 + count * 3)
    if get(w, 48) == 0:
        put(w, bb + 8, count)
    if b == get(w, FBASE + get(w, 72) * FSTRIDE + 264):
        if count != get(w, FBASE + get(w, 72) * FSTRIDE + 24):
            fail(w, 12)
    if get(w, 40) != 0:
        return 0
    loan_incoming(w, bb, count, b)
    put(w, 96, b + 1)
    expect(s, w, 10)
    while get(w, 40) == 0 and instruction_ahead(s, w) != 0:
        instruction(s, o, w)
    if get(w, 8) == @ret@:
        next_token(s, w)
        adjacent(w)
        return_results(s, o, w)
    else:
        if get(w, 8) == @trap@:
            explicit_trap(s, o, w)
            expect(s, w, 10)
            return 0
        if get(w, 8) == @jump@:
            next_token(s, w)
            edge(s, o, w, 0)
        else:
            expect(s, w, @branch@)
            account_nodes(w, 1)
            separated(w)
            v = expect(s, w, 256)
            if variable(w, v) != 5:
                fail(w, 14)
            load_var(o, w, 0, v, 0)
            emit(o, w, 72)
            emit(o, w, 133)
            emit(o, w, 192)
            emit(o, w, 15)
            emit(o, w, 132)
            at = get(w, 56)
            emit4(o, w, 0)
            edge(s, o, w, 0)
            if get(w, 48) == 2:
                write4(o, at, get(w, 56) - at - 4)
            edge(s, o, w, 1)
    expect(s, w, 10)
    return 0

def args(s:readbuf, w:mutbuf, is_edge:u64) -> u64:
    expect(s, w, 40)
    n = 0
    v = 0
    t = 0
    j = 0
    while get(w, 8) != 41 and get(w, 40) == 0:
        v = expect(s, w, 256)
        t = variable(w, v)
        if n >= 16:
            return fail(w, 15)
        j = 0
        while j < n:
            if v == get(w, ARGS + j * 8) and ((t >= 7 and t <= 9) or (is_edge == 1 and t == 6)):
                fail(w, 16)
            j = j + 1
        put(w, ARGS + n * 8, v)
        n = n + 1
        if get(w, 8) != 41:
            expect(s, w, 44)
            if get(w, 8) == 41:
                fail(w, 17)
    expect(s, w, 41)
    put(w, 136, n)
    return n

def edge(s:readbuf, o:mutbuf, w:mutbuf, arm:u64) -> u64:
    separated(w)
    b = expect(s, w, 258)
    adjacent(w)
    fbase = FBASE + get(w, 72) * FSTRIDE
    bid = get(w, fbase + 8) + b
    if b == get(w, fbase + 264) or b >= 256 or bid >= 1536:
        return fail(w, 18)
    bb = BBASE + bid * BSTRIDE
    n = args(s, w, 1)
    loan_transfer(w, bid, n)
    account_nodes(w, 4 + n)
    if get(w, 48) == 0:
        put(w, BBASE + get(w, 88) * BSTRIDE + 288 + arm * 8, bid)
    else:
        if b >= get(w, fbase + 16) or n != get(w, bb + 8):
            return fail(w, 19)
        i = 0
        v = 0
        t = 0
        while i < n:
            v = get(w, ARGS + i * 8)
            t = variable(w, v)
            if t != get(w, bb + 40 + i * 16):
                fail(w, 20)
            copy_argument(o, w, v, i, t)
            i = i + 1
        i = 0
        while i < n:
            v = get(w, bb + 32 + i * 16)
            t = get(w, bb + 40 + i * 16)
            mem(o, w, 139, 0, 5, 0 - frame(w) + i * 16)
            store_var(o, w, v, 0)
            if t >= 6 and t <= 9:
                mem(o, w, 139, 0, 5, 0 - frame(w) + i * 16 + 8)
                store_var(o, w, v, 1)
            i = i + 1
        emit(o, w, 233)
        relocation(o, w, 2, bid)
    return 0

def instruction(s:readbuf, o:mutbuf, w:mutbuf) -> u64:
    if get(w, 112) >= MAX_INSTRUCTIONS:
        return fail(w, 54)
    put(w, 112, get(w, 112) + 1)
    owned_read_outputs(s, w)
    v = get(w, 296)
    t = get(w, 304)
    expect(s, w, 61)
    op = get(w, 8)
    require_effects(w, instruction_effects(op))
    x = get(w, 288)
    if x > 1 and op != @call@ and op != @buffer.try_new@ and op != @chain.try_push@ and op != @chain.pop@:
        return fail(w, 66)
    if (t >= 6 and t <= 9) and op != @borrow.read@ and op != @borrow.mut@ and op != @call@ and (op < @buffer.new@ or op > @chain.head_mut@):
        fail(w, 21)
    next_token(s, w)
    adjacent(w)
    n = args(s, w, 0)
    account_nodes(w, 5 + n)
    account_nodes(w, get(w, 288) * 3)
    x = 0
    a = 0
    b = 0
    at = 0
    bt = 0
    if n > 0:
        a = get(w, ARGS)
        at = variable(w, a)
    if n > 1:
        b = get(w, ARGS + 8)
        bt = variable(w, b)
    if op >= @buffer.new@ and op <= @chain.head_mut@:
        owned_instruction(o, w, op, n, a, at)
        owned_define_outputs(w)
        if get(w, 40) != 0:
            return 0
        if op == @chain.head_read@ or op == @chain.head_mut@:
            loan_produce(w, v, a)
        expect(s, w, 10)
        return 0
    if op == @const@:
        account_nodes(w, 1)
        separated(w)
        expect(s, w, 123)
        expect(s, w, @value@)
        expect(s, w, 58)
        x = scalar_literal(s, w, t)
        expect(s, w, 125)
        if n != 0:
            fail(w, 22)
        emit(o, w, 72)
        emit(o, w, 184)
        emit8(o, w, x)
    else:
        if op == @call@:
            loan_call(w, n)
            account_nodes(w, 1)
            separated(w)
            expect(s, w, 123)
            expect(s, w, @function@)
            expect(s, w, 58)
            if get(w, 32) != 1:
                fail(w, 49)
            x = read_function_name(s, w, 0)
            expect(s, w, 125)
            if x >= 128:
                fail(w, 23)
            else:
                if get(w, 432) == 0:
                    if x == get(w, 72):
                        put(w, 256, v + 1)
                    else:
                        if get(w, 48) == 0:
                            store(w, CBASE + get(w, 72) * 128 + x, 1)
            if get(w, 48) > 0:
                if x >= get(w, 1024):
                    fail(w, 23)
                fb = FBASE + x * FSTRIDE
                require_effects(w, get(w, fb + 176))
                if n != get(w, fb + 24) or t != get(w, fb + 32):
                    fail(w, 24)
                i = 0
                av = 0
                typ = 0
                while i < n:
                    av = get(w, ARGS + i * 8)
                    typ = variable(w, av)
                    if typ != get(w, fb + 48 + i * 8):
                        fail(w, 25)
                    copy_argument(o, w, av, i, typ)
                    i = i + 1
                if x == get(w, 72):
                    # All arguments were staged before overwriting any entry
                    # parameter. Keep the frame and original result pointer;
                    # The declared entry begins after the prologue, including
                    # stack probes; it need not be the first source block.
                    i = 0
                    while i < n:
                        mem(o, w, 139, 0, 5, 0 - frame(w) + i * 16)
                        store_var(o, w, i, 0)
                        if resource_type(get(w, fb + 48 + i * 8)) == 1:
                            mem(o, w, 139, 0, 5, 0 - frame(w) + i * 16 + 8)
                            store_var(o, w, i, 1)
                        i = i + 1
                    emit(o, w, 233)
                    relocation(o, w, 2, get(w, fb + 8) + get(w, fb + 264))
                else:
                    mem(o, w, 141, 7, 5, 0 - frame(w))
                    mem(o, w, 141, 6, 5, 0 - frame(w) + 512)
                    emit(o, w, 232)
                    relocation(o, w, 1, x)
            owner_call_consume(w, n)
            call_results(o, w, x)
            expect(s, w, 10)
            if get(w, 256) != 0 and get(w, 8) != @ret@:
                fail(w, 59)
            return 0
        else:
            if op == @int.cast@:
                account_nodes(w, 1)
                separated(w)
                expect(s, w, 123)
                expect(s, w, @mode@)
                expect(s, w, 58)
                if get(w, 8) == @checked@:
                    x = 1
                    require_effects(w, 8)
                    next_token(s, w)
                else:
                    expect(s, w, @wrap@)
                expect(s, w, 125)
                if n != 1 or integer_type(at) != 1 or integer_type(t) != 1:
                    fail(w, 26)
                load_var(o, w, 0, a, 0)
                cast_integer(o, w, t, x, at)
            else:
                if op >= @borrow.read@ and op <= @loan.end@:
                    loan_operation(w, op, n, a, at, t)
                else:
                    if op >= @bit.not@ and op <= @int.neg.checked@ and op != @select@:
                        checked_integer(o, w, op, n, a, b, at, bt, t)
                    else:
                        operation_dispatch(o, w, op, n, a, b, at, bt, t)
    if t != 0:
        define(w, v, t)
        if get(w, 40) != 0:
            return 0
        if op == @borrow.read@ or op == @borrow.mut@:
            loan_produce(w, v, a)
            load_var(o, w, 0, a, 1)
            store_var(o, w, v, 1)
            load_var(o, w, 0, a, 0)
        if get(w, 256) == 0:
            store_var(o, w, v, 0)
    else:
        if op != @buffer.store@ and op != @buffer.swap@ and op != @loan.end@ and (op < @buffer.fill@ or op > @buffer.move_within@):
            fail(w, 27)
    expect(s, w, 10)
    if get(w, 256) != 0 and get(w, 8) != @ret@:
        fail(w, 59)
    return 0

def operation(o:mutbuf, w:mutbuf, op:u64, n:u64, a:u64, b:u64, at:u64, bt:u64, t:u64) -> u64:
    if op == @select@:
        return select_scalar(o, w, n, a, b, at, bt, t)
    if op == @buffer.len@:
        if n != 1 or at < 6 or at > 8 or t != 2:
            fail(w, 28)
        load_var(o, w, 0, a, 1)
        return 0
    if op == @buffer.swap@:
        loan_access(w, a)
        if n != 3 or t != 0 or at != 7 or bt != 2 or variable(w, get(w, ARGS + 16)) != 2:
            fail(w, 57)
        load_var(o, w, 1, b, 0)
        load_var(o, w, 2, a, 1)
        # cmp rcx, rdx; jb +2; ud2; nop. Both checks precede all memory access.
        emit8(o, w, 10379406269396105544)
        load_var(o, w, 6, get(w, ARGS + 16), 0)
        emit8(o, w, 10379406269396433224)
        load_var(o, w, 0, a, 0)
        # add rcx, rax; add rsi, rax; movzx edx, [rcx]; mov al, [rsi];
        # mov [rcx], al; mov [rsi], dl; nop. All value slots stay in memory.
        emit8(o, w, 13118921948371419464)
        emit8(o, w, 10382635531107731985)
        return 0

def emit_bytes(o:mutbuf, w:mutbuf, x:u64, remaining:u64) -> u64:
    if remaining == 0:
        return 0
    phase = get(w, 48)
    if phase == 0:
        return 0
    pos = get(w, 56)
    if phase == 1 or (pos <= length(o) and remaining <= length(o) - pos):
        if phase == 2:
            i = 0
            while i < remaining:
                store(o, pos + i, x & 255)
                x = x >> 8
                i = i + 1
        put(w, 56, pos + remaining)
        return 0

    # counter updates before the original buffer.store trap. No trap is hidden.
    emit(o, w, x & 255)
    return emit_bytes(o, w, x >> 8, remaining - 1)

# Appending this helper preserves all existing compiler function identities.
def checked_integer(o:mutbuf, w:mutbuf, op:u64, n:u64, a:u64, b:u64, at:u64, bt:u64, t:u64) -> u64:
    if signed_type(at) == 1:
        return signed_integer(o, w, op, n, a, b, at, bt, t)
    load_var(o, w, 0, a, 0)
    if op == @bit.not@:
        if n != 1 or at < 1 or (at > 4 and at != 10) or t != at:
            fail(w, 31)
        # NOT is a full machine word operation; restore the declared width.
        emit(o, w, 72)
        emit(o, w, 247)
        emit(o, w, 208)
        normalize(o, w, t)
        return 0
    if op == @int.neg.checked@:
        if n != 1 or at < 1 or (at > 4 and at != 10) or t != at:
            fail(w, 31)
        # The only representable unsigned negation is zero. Test before any
        # later operation, preserving all earlier observable stores.
        emit_bytes(o, w, 3112727966942536, 7)
        return 0
    if n != 2 or at != bt or t != at or t == 0 or (t > 4 and t != 10):
        fail(w, 34)
    load_var(o, w, 1, b, 0)
    if op == @int.div.checked@ or op == @int.rem.checked@:
        # test rcx,rcx; jne +2; ud2; xor edx,edx; div rcx. Clearing the
        # dividend's upper half avoids machine overflow for every u64 input.
        emit_bytes(o, w, 3112727984309576, 7)
        emit_bytes(o, w, 1039235863089, 5)
        if op == @int.rem.checked@:
            emit_bytes(o, w, 13666632, 3)
        return 0
    if op == @int.mul.checked@:
        # Unsigned MUL sets CF iff the high half is nonzero. IMUL's signed
        # overflow flag would reject legal high-bit operands such as MAX*1.
        emit_bytes(o, w, 3112727952357192, 7)
    else:
        if op != @int.add.checked@ and op != @int.sub.checked@:
            return fail(w, 36)
        # Operands are zero extended. Preserve CF until the first branch:
        # add/sub rax, rcx; jnc +2; ud2. This checks 64-bit carry/borrow.
        emit(o, w, 72)
        if op == @int.add.checked@:
            emit(o, w, 1)
        else:
            emit(o, w, 41)
        emit(o, w, 200)
        emit(o, w, 115)
        emit(o, w, 2)
        emit(o, w, 15)
        emit(o, w, 11)

        # result, normalize rax, then require that no high bits were lost.
        emit(o, w, 72)
        emit(o, w, 137)
        emit(o, w, 193)
        normalize(o, w, t)
        emit(o, w, 72)
        emit(o, w, 57)
        emit(o, w, 200)
        emit(o, w, 116)
        emit(o, w, 2)
        emit(o, w, 15)
        emit(o, w, 11)
    normalize(o, w, t)
    return 0

def bulk_buffer(o:mutbuf, w:mutbuf, op:u64, n:u64, a:u64, b:u64, at:u64, bt:u64, t:u64) -> u64:
    loan_access(w, a)
    if at != 7 or t != 0:
        return fail(w, 61)

    d = get(w, ARGS + 24)
    e = get(w, ARGS + 32)

        if n != 2 or bt != 4:
            return fail(w, 61)

        load_var(o, w, 0, b, 0)
        load_var(o, w, 7, a, 0)

            return fail(w, 61)
        bulk_range_guard(o, w, a, b, c)

            if n != 4 or bt != 2 or variable(w, c) != 2 or variable(w, d) != 2:
                return fail(w, 61)
            bulk_range_guard(o, w, a, b, d)
            bulk_range_guard(o, w, a, c, d)
        else:

            # as well as active, unsuspended source/destination capabilities.
            if bt != 6:
                return fail(w, 61)
            loan_access(w, b)
            if get(w, 264) == 1 and get(w, CAPBASE + a * 24) == get(w, CAPBASE + b * 24):
                return fail(w, 62)

                if n != 3 or variable(w, c) != 2:
                    return fail(w, 61)
                load_var(o, w, 1, c, 0)
                load_var(o, w, 0, a, 1)
                emit_bytes(o, w, 3112728000543048, 7)
                load_var(o, w, 0, b, 1)
                emit_bytes(o, w, 3112728000543048, 7)
            else:
                if op != @buffer.copy_range@ or n != 5 or variable(w, c) != 2 or variable(w, d) != 2 or variable(w, e) != 2:
                    return fail(w, 61)
                bulk_range_guard(o, w, a, c, e)
                bulk_range_guard(o, w, b, d, e)

    emit_bytes(o, w, 567200548168, 5)
    done = get(w, 56)
    emit4(o, w, 0)
    load_var(o, w, 7, a, 0)
    if op == @buffer.fill_range@:
        load_var(o, w, 0, b, 0)
        emit_bytes(o, w, 13041992, 3)
        load_var(o, w, 0, d, 0)
        emit_bytes(o, w, 11203580, 3)
    else:
        if op == @buffer.move_within@:
            load_var(o, w, 6, a, 0)
            load_var(o, w, 0, b, 0)
            emit_bytes(o, w, 13041992, 3)
            load_var(o, w, 0, c, 0)

            # forward path also explicitly clears DF. All registers volatile.
            emit_bytes(o, w, 70715390280, 5)
            emit_bytes(o, w, 1095476481352, 5)
            emit_bytes(o, w, 1095459179848, 5)
            emit_bytes(o, w, 17580931357438440445, 8)

        else:
            load_var(o, w, 6, b, 0)
            if op == @buffer.copy_range@:
                load_var(o, w, 0, c, 0)
                emit_bytes(o, w, 13041992, 3)
                load_var(o, w, 0, d, 0)
                emit_bytes(o, w, 12976456, 3)
            emit_bytes(o, w, 10810364, 3)

    return 0

def operation_dispatch(o:mutbuf, w:mutbuf, op:u64, n:u64, a:u64, b:u64, at:u64, bt:u64, t:u64) -> u64:
    if op >= @buffer.fill@ and op <= @buffer.move_within@:
        return bulk_buffer(o, w, op, n, a, b, at, bt, t)
    return operation(o, w, op, n, a, b, at, bt, t)

def loan_live(w:mutbuf, v:u64) -> u64:
    if get(w, VBASE + v * 16 + 8) == get(w, 88) + 1 and resource_type(get(w, VBASE + v * 16)) == 1 and get(w, CAPBASE + v * 24 + 16) == 1:
        return 1
    return 0

def loan_access(w:mutbuf, v:u64) -> u64:
    if get(w, 264) == 0 or get(w, 280) == 0:
        return 0
    interned_count = get(w, 480)
    i = 0
    # Every live SSA identity was interned by read_value_name(). Slots
    # outside this current-function count retain type zero after table reset
    # and cannot satisfy loan_live(), including with dirty initial workspace.
    while i < interned_count:
        if loan_live(w, i) == 1 and get(w, CAPBASE + i * 24 + 8) == v + 1:
            return fail(w, 62)
        i = i + 1
    return 0

def loan_ancestor(w:mutbuf, candidate:u64, source:u64) -> u64:
    cursor = source + 1
    depth = 0
    while cursor != 0 and depth < 2048:
        if cursor == candidate + 1:
            return 1
        cursor = get(w, CAPBASE + (cursor - 1) * 24 + 8)
        depth = depth + 1
    if cursor != 0:
        fail(w, 62)
    return 0

    if n != 1 or at < 6 or at > 8:
        return fail(w, 62)
    if op == @loan.end@:
        if t != 0 or at > 7:
            return fail(w, 62)
        if get(w, 264) == 1:
            if get(w, CAPBASE + a * 24 + 8) == 0:
                return fail(w, 62)
            loan_access(w, a)
            put(w, CAPBASE + a * 24 + 16, 0)
            put(w, 280, get(w, 280) - 1)
        return 0
    if op == @borrow.read@:
        if t != 6:
            return fail(w, 62)
    else:
        if op != @borrow.mut@ or (at != 7 and at != 8) or t != 7:
            return fail(w, 62)
    return loan_borrow(w, a, t)

def loan_borrow(w:mutbuf, a:u64, t:u64) -> u64:
    if get(w, 264) == 0 or get(w, 280) == 0:
        return 0
    interned_count = get(w, 480)
    i = 0
    root = get(w, CAPBASE + a * 24)
    # Every live SSA identity was interned by read_value_name(). Slots
    # outside this current-function count retain type zero after table reset
    # and cannot satisfy loan_live(), including with dirty initial workspace.
    while i < interned_count:
        if loan_live(w, i) == 1 and get(w, CAPBASE + i * 24) == root:
            if loan_ancestor(w, i, a) == 0:
                if t == 7 or get(w, VBASE + i * 16) == 7:

    return 0

    i = 0
    j = 0
    v = 0
    other = 0

        text = text.replace(f'get(w, {at})', f'byte(w, {at})')
        text = text.replace(f'put(w, {at},', f'store(w, {at},')
    # Private cursors/kinds/errors, output offsets and bounded Core counters.
    # Source positions are bounded by the <=1MiB input; token kinds/errors are
    # a closed inventory, blocks/SSA/arguments/relocations/nodes have the above
    # fixed admission limits. Output positions count only fixed templates for
    # <=8192 instructions/1536 blocks/128 functions, never user-sized emission.
    # Full header clearing leaves these words' high four bytes zero every pass.
    # Do not narrow numeric token payloads (word16), arbitrary SSA constants,
    # table entries, public values or the generic get/put helper semantics.
    for at in (0, 8, 24, 40, 56, 80, 88, 96, 104, 112, 120, 136, 224, 240, 248):
        text = text.replace(f'get(w, {at})', f'state_get32(w, {at})')
        text = text.replace(f'put(w, {at},', f'state_put32(w, {at},')
    return text


class Builder:
    def __init__(self, node, names, signatures, total_calls=frozenset()):
        self.node,self.names,self.signatures = node,names,signatures
        self.total_calls = frozenset(total_calls)
        self.block_constants = {}
        self.serial=0; self.blocks=[]; self.env={}; self.block=None
        self.returns=node.returns.id
        params=[]
        for a in node.args.args:
            v=self.value(a.annotation.id); self.env[a.arg]=v; params.append(v)
        self.params=params
        self.block={'id':'b0','params':[self.param(v) for v in params],'ops':[]}
        self.blocks.append(self.block)

    def value(self,t):
        v=(f'v{self.serial}',t); self.serial+=1; return v
    def param(self,v): return {'name':v[0],'type':v[1]}
    def op(self,op,args,t=None,**attrs):
        out=[] if t is None else [self.value(t)]
        self.block['ops'].append({'op':op,'args':[a[0] for a in args],'out':[self.param(x) for x in out],'attrs':attrs})
        return out[0] if out else None
    def c(self,v,t='u64'):
        # Constants are total and immutable. Share only inside this exact SSA
        # block: no cross-block dominance assumption or operation elimination.
        cache = self.block_constants.setdefault(self.block['id'], {})
        key = (t, type(v), v)
        if key not in cache:
            cache[key] = self.op('const', [], t, value=v)
        return cache[key]
    def cast(self,x,t): return x if x[1]==t else self.op('int.cast',[x],t,mode='wrap')
    def fresh(self,env):
        new={k:self.value(v[1]) for k,v in env.items()}
        b={'id':'b'+str(len(self.blocks)),'params':[self.param(v) for v in new.values()],'ops':[]}
        self.blocks.append(b)
        return b,new
    def edge(self,b,env): return {'target':b['id'],'args':[env[k][0] for k in self.env_template(b)]}
    def env_template(self,b):
        return self.block_env_keys[b['id']]
    def jump(self,b,env,keys): self.block['term']={'op':'jump','target':b['id'],'args':[env[k][0] for k in keys]}
    def total_scalar_expression(self, e):
        # Only expressions with no unproven calls, reads, checked shifts or other
        # possible effects can replace short-circuit branches with bool ops.
        if isinstance(e, (ast.Name, ast.Constant)):
            return True
        if isinstance(e, ast.Compare):
            return (len(e.ops) == 1 and self.total_scalar_expression(e.left)
                    and self.total_scalar_expression(e.comparators[0]))
        if isinstance(e, ast.BinOp):
            return (isinstance(e.op, (ast.Add, ast.Sub, ast.Mult, ast.BitAnd, ast.BitOr, ast.BitXor))
                    and self.total_scalar_expression(e.left)
                    and self.total_scalar_expression(e.right))
        if isinstance(e, ast.BoolOp):
            return all(self.total_scalar_expression(v) for v in e.values)
        if isinstance(e, ast.Call):
            return (isinstance(e.func, ast.Name) and e.func.id in self.total_calls
                    and not e.keywords and all(self.total_scalar_expression(v) for v in e.args))
        return False
    def expr(self,e):
        if isinstance(e,ast.Name): return self.env[e.id]
        if isinstance(e,ast.Constant): return self.c(e.value,'bool' if type(e.value) is bool else 'u64')
        if isinstance(e,ast.BinOp):
            x,y=self.expr(e.left),self.expr(e.right)
            op={ast.Add:'int.add.wrap',ast.Sub:'int.sub.wrap',ast.Mult:'int.mul.wrap',ast.BitAnd:'bit.and',ast.BitOr:'bit.or',ast.BitXor:'bit.xor',ast.LShift:'int.shl.checked',ast.RShift:'int.shr.checked'}[type(e.op)]
            return self.op(op,[x,y],x[1])
        if isinstance(e,ast.Compare):
            assert len(e.ops)==1
            x,y=self.expr(e.left),self.expr(e.comparators[0])
            op={ast.Eq:'eq',ast.NotEq:'ne',ast.Lt:'lt',ast.LtE:'le',ast.Gt:'gt',ast.GtE:'ge'}[type(e.ops[0])]
            return self.op('compare.'+op,[x,y],'bool')
        if isinstance(e,ast.BoolOp):
            if self.total_scalar_expression(e):
                val = self.expr(e.values[0])
                for other in e.values[1:]:
                    val = self.op('bool.and' if isinstance(e.op, ast.And) else 'bool.or',
                                  [val, self.expr(other)], 'bool')
                return val
            # Short circuit is essential for byte-at-end guards.
            val=self.expr(e.values[0])
            for tail in e.values[1:]:
                original=dict(self.env); key='shortcircuit'+str(self.serial)
                original[key]=val
                keys=list(original)
                calc,cen=self.fresh(original); done,denv=self.fresh(original)
                # The short-circuit arm already has the exact result and
                # environment expected by done. Route that edge directly to
                # the join; an empty forwarding block adds no semantics.
                evaluate={'target':calc['id'],'args':[x[0] for x in original.values()]}
                retain={'target':done['id'],'args':[x[0] for x in original.values()]}
                self.block['term']={'op':'branch','cond':val[0],
                    'then':evaluate if isinstance(e.op,ast.And) else retain,
                    'else':retain if isinstance(e.op,ast.And) else evaluate}
                self.block,self.env=calc,cen; self.env[key]=self.expr(tail); self.jump(done,self.env,keys)
                self.block,self.env=done,denv; val=self.env.pop(key)
            return val
        if isinstance(e,ast.Call):
            name=e.func.id; args=[self.expr(x) for x in e.args]
            if name=='length': return self.cast(self.op('buffer.len',args,'usize'),'u64')
            if name=='byte': return self.cast(self.op('buffer.load',[args[0],self.cast(args[1],'usize')],'u8'),'u64')
            if name=='store': return self.op('buffer.store',[args[0],self.cast(args[1],'usize'),self.cast(args[2],'u8')])
            if name=='fill_range': return self.op('buffer.fill_range',[args[0],self.cast(args[1],'usize'),self.cast(args[2],'usize'),self.cast(args[3],'u8')])
            if name=='choose':
                assert len(args)==3 and args[0][1]=='bool' and args[1][1]==args[2][1]
                return self.op('select',args,args[1][1])
            sig=self.signatures[name]
            assert len(args)==len(sig[0]),name
            converted=[self.cast(a,t) if a[1]!=t else a for a,t in zip(args,sig[0])]
            return self.op('call',converted,sig[1],function=self.names[name])
        raise ValueError(ast.dump(e))

    def statements(self, statements):
        for index, s in enumerate(statements):
            if 'term' in self.block: break
            if isinstance(s,ast.Assign):
                assert len(s.targets)==1 and isinstance(s.targets[0],ast.Name)
                self.env[s.targets[0].id]=self.expr(s.value)
            elif isinstance(s,ast.Expr): self.expr(s.value)
            elif isinstance(s,ast.Return):
                val=self.cast(self.expr(s.value),self.returns)
                self.block['term']={'op':'ret','values':[val[0]]}
            elif isinstance(s,ast.If):
                # Only total scalar arm expressions may be evaluated eagerly.
                # Conditions retain ordinary short-circuit lowering. Never
                # speculate an unproven call, memory access or checked shift.
                arm = s.body[0] if len(s.body) == 1 else None
                other = s.orelse[0] if len(s.orelse) == 1 else None
                # Share only this exact conditional *effect*, not its
                # condition or a potentially effectful argument evaluation.
                # The helper branches before calling the original fail;
                # unlike predication, a false guard performs no workspace I/O.
                call = arm.value if isinstance(arm, ast.Expr) else None
                if (not s.orelse and self.node.name != 'guard_failure'
                        and 'guard_failure' in self.names
                        and self.signatures.get('guard_failure') == (['bool', 'mutbuf', 'u64'], 'u64')
                        and isinstance(call, ast.Call) and isinstance(call.func, ast.Name)
                        and call.func.id == 'fail' and not call.keywords and len(call.args) == 2
                        and isinstance(call.args[0], ast.Name)
                        and self.env[call.args[0].id][1] == 'mutbuf'
                        and isinstance(call.args[1], ast.Constant) and type(call.args[1].value) is int
                        and 0 <= call.args[1].value < (1 << 64)):
                    condition = self.expr(s.test)
                    assert condition[1] == 'bool'
                    self.op('call', [condition, self.expr(call.args[0]), self.expr(call.args[1])],
                            'u64', function=self.names['guard_failure'])
                    continue
                if (isinstance(arm, ast.Assign) and len(arm.targets) == 1
                        and isinstance(arm.targets[0], ast.Name)
                        and arm.targets[0].id in self.env
                        and self.total_scalar_expression(arm.value)
                        and (not s.orelse or isinstance(other, ast.Assign)
                             and len(other.targets) == 1 and isinstance(other.targets[0], ast.Name)
                             and other.targets[0].id == arm.targets[0].id
                             and self.total_scalar_expression(other.value))):
                    target = arm.targets[0].id
                    condition = self.expr(s.test)
                    before = self.env[target]
                    yes = self.expr(arm.value)
                    no = self.expr(other.value) if other is not None else before
                    assert yes[1] == no[1] == before[1]
                    self.env[target] = self.op('select', [condition, yes, no], before[1])
                    continue
                fallback = other
                if not s.orelse and index + 1 < len(statements):
                    fallback = statements[index + 1]
                if (isinstance(arm, ast.Return) and isinstance(fallback, ast.Return)
                        and self.total_scalar_expression(arm.value)
                        and self.total_scalar_expression(fallback.value)):
                    condition = self.expr(s.test)
                    yes = self.cast(self.expr(arm.value), self.returns)
                    no = self.cast(self.expr(fallback.value), self.returns)
                    self.block['term'] = {'op': 'ret', 'values': [self.op('select', [condition, yes, no], self.returns)[0]]}
                    continue
                cond=self.expr(s.test); base=dict(self.env); keys=list(base)
                yes,ye=self.fresh(base); no,ne=self.fresh(base)
                self.block['term']={'op':'branch','cond':cond[0],'then':{'target':yes['id'],'args':[v[0] for v in base.values()]},'else':{'target':no['id'],'args':[v[0] for v in base.values()]}}
                self.block,self.env=yes,ye; self.statements(s.body); yb,yend=self.block,dict(self.env)
                self.block,self.env=no,ne; self.statements(s.orelse); nb,nend=self.block,dict(self.env)
                live=[(b,e) for b,e in [(yb,yend),(nb,nend)] if 'term' not in b]
                if not live:
                    self.block,self.env=yb,yend; continue
                if len(live) == 1:
                    # Only one branch reaches the following statement. Its
                    # actual environment already is the join; a fresh block
                    # would add only an unconditional parallel identity move.
                    self.block,self.env=live[0]; continue
                # Variables introduced on only one path cannot escape that path.
                common=[k for k in live[0][1] if all(k in e for b,e in live)]
                merged={k:live[0][1][k] for k in common}
                done,de=self.fresh(merged)
                for b,e in live:
                    self.block,self.env=b,e; self.jump(done,e,common)
                self.block,self.env=done,de
            elif isinstance(s,ast.While):
                base=dict(self.env); keys=list(base)
                entry,ee=self.fresh(base); self.jump(entry,self.env,keys)
                self.block,self.env=entry,ee
                cond=self.expr(s.test); head=self.block; he=dict(self.env)
                body,be=self.fresh(he); done,de=self.fresh(he)
                head['term']={'op':'branch','cond':cond[0],'then':{'target':body['id'],'args':[v[0] for v in he.values()]},'else':{'target':done['id'],'args':[v[0] for v in he.values()]}}
                self.block,self.env=body,be; self.statements(s.body)
                if 'term' not in self.block: self.jump(entry,self.env,keys)
                self.block,self.env=done,de
            else: raise ValueError(ast.dump(s))


def total_scalar_functions(nodes):
    """Infer a closed, acyclic set of finite scalar-only authoring functions.

    No memory, loops, checked arithmetic/shifts, imports or recursive calls can
    enter this set. Membership is derived from the actual AST, not a trusted
    function name. It authorizes eager evaluation only, never removes a call.
    """
    total = set()
    scalar = set(TYPES) - {"readbuf", "mutbuf", "buffer", "chain"}
    def statements(builder, body):
        for statement in body:
            if isinstance(statement, ast.Return):
                if not builder.total_scalar_expression(statement.value):
                    return False
            elif isinstance(statement, ast.Assign):
                if (len(statement.targets) != 1 or not isinstance(statement.targets[0], ast.Name)
                        or not builder.total_scalar_expression(statement.value)):
                    return False
            elif isinstance(statement, ast.If):
                if (not builder.total_scalar_expression(statement.test)
                        or not statements(builder, statement.body)
                        or not statements(builder, statement.orelse)):
                    return False
            else:
                return False
        return True
    while True:
        previous = set(total)
        for node in nodes:
            if (not isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) or not isinstance(node.returns, ast.Name)
                    or node.returns.id not in scalar or node.decorator_list
                    or node.args.defaults or node.args.kw_defaults or node.args.vararg or node.args.kwarg
                    or node.args.kwonlyargs or node.args.posonlyargs
                    or any(not isinstance(arg.annotation, ast.Name) or arg.annotation.id not in scalar
                           for arg in node.args.args)):
                continue
            builder = Builder(node, {}, {}, previous)
            if statements(builder, node.body):
                total.add(node.name)
        if total == previous:
            return frozenset(total)


def compact_authoring_cfg(document):
    """Compose parameter-only forwarding edges in the authoring output.

    This is not an optimization of programs supplied to the native compiler.
    Both documents pass the ordinary Core verifier. Entry parameters, resource
    parameters, operations, branch conditions and empty forwarding cycles are
    retained. Unobserved scalar-only edge parameters are pruned by a backwards
    fixed point; parallel arguments are substituted simultaneously, never as
    sequential assignments. VM step counts are not an equivalence claim.
    """
    from copy import deepcopy
    from hepta.hia_program import verify_program
    verify_program(document)
    result = deepcopy(document)
    for function in result['functions']:
        def edges(block):
            term = block['term']
            return ([term] if term['op'] == 'jump' else
                    [term['then'], term['else']] if term['op'] == 'branch' else [])

        blocks = {b['id']: b for b in function['blocks']}
        # Operations are NOT dead-code eliminated: every argument of every
        # operation is a root, including checked/trapping and effectful ops.
        # Keep ALL resource and entry parameters, even if syntactically unused.
        scalar = set(TYPES) - {'readbuf', 'mutbuf', 'buffer', 'chain'}
        live = set()
        for block in function['blocks']:
            used = {arg for op in block['ops'] for arg in op['args']}
            term = block['term']
            used.update(term['values'] if term['op'] == 'ret' else
                        [term['cond']] if term['op'] == 'branch' else [])
            for param in block['params']:
                typ = param['type']
                if (block['id'] == function['entry'] or not isinstance(typ, str)
                        or typ not in scalar or param['name'] in used):
                    live.add((block['id'], param['name']))
        while True:
            previous = set(live)
            for block in function['blocks']:
                params = {p['name'] for p in block['params']}
                for edge in edges(block):
                    for actual, formal in zip(edge['args'], blocks[edge['target']]['params'], strict=True):
                        if (edge['target'], formal['name']) in live and actual in params:
                            live.add((block['id'], actual))
            if live == previous:
                break
        keep = {b['id']: [i for i, p in enumerate(b['params']) if (b['id'], p['name']) in live]
                for b in function['blocks']}
        for block in function['blocks']:
            for edge in edges(block):
                edge['args'] = [edge['args'][i] for i in keep[edge['target']]]
            block['params'] = [block['params'][i] for i in keep[block['id']]]
        while True:
            candidates = {block['id']: block for block in function['blocks']
                if block['id'] != function['entry'] and not block['ops']
                and block['term']['op'] == 'jump'
                and block['term']['target'] != block['id']
                and set(block['term']['args']) <= {p['name'] for p in block['params']}}
            selected = None
            for name, block in candidates.items():
                seen = {name}
                target = block['term']['target']
                while target in candidates and target not in seen:
                    seen.add(target)
                    target = candidates[target]['term']['target']
                if target not in seen:
                    selected = block
                    break
            if selected is None:
                break
            names = [p['name'] for p in selected['params']]
            for block in function['blocks']:
                for edge in edges(block):
                    if edge['target'] == selected['id']:
                        actual = dict(zip(names, edge['args'], strict=True))
                        edge['args'] = [actual[name] for name in selected['term']['args']]
                        edge['target'] = selected['term']['target']
            function['blocks'] = [b for b in function['blocks'] if b is not selected]
    verify_program(result)
    return result


def _source_function_names(nodes):
    """Number the actual authoring definitions without lowering their bodies."""
    assert nodes[0].name == 'compile'
    return {node.name: 'f' + str(index) for index, node in enumerate(nodes)}


def function_names():
    """Fresh source-order spellings; no generated Core or verified authority.

    The names witness needs only this table. Its original and renamed source
    programs still undergo every independent assembly, round trip and native
    observation. Constructing an unused authoring CFG adds no such observation.
    """
    return _source_function_names(ast.parse(source_program()).body)


def document(*, compact=True):
    nodes=ast.parse(source_program()).body
    # Source order deliberately contains backward direct calls. The HIA
    # compiler's call-graph checker, not author-time topological numbering,
    # admits its non-self DAG and checked direct tail self calls. General
    # recursive cycles remain outside the native fixed profile.
    ordered=nodes
    names = _source_function_names(ordered)
    sigs={n.name:([a.annotation.id for a in n.args.args],n.returns.id) for n in ordered}
    total_calls = total_scalar_functions(ordered)
    functions=[]
    for n in ordered:
        b=Builder(n,names,sigs,total_calls)
        b.statements(n.body)
        functions.append({'name':names[n.name],'params':[b.param(x) for x in b.params],'returns':[b.returns], 'effects':['read','write','trap'],'entry':'b0','blocks':b.blocks})
    doc = {'schema':'hepta.hia.program.v8','module':'selfhost','functions':functions}
    return (compact_authoring_cfg(doc) if compact else doc), names


def main():
    doc,names=document()
    output=ROOT/'examples/hia_bootstrap/selfhost.hepta'
    output.write_text(render_assembly(doc))
    print(json.dumps({'bytes':output.stat().st_size,'functions':names,'operations':sum(len(b['ops']) for f in doc['functions'] for b in f['blocks']),'blocks':sum(len(f['blocks']) for f in doc['functions'])},sort_keys=True))

if __name__=='__main__': main()

            # Clear only this block's definitions before replay so neither
            # variable() nor loan_live() can observe a future instruction's
            # stale capability. define() keeps its ordinary strict check.
            i = 0

    put(w, 112, instructions)

    put(w, 344, externals)

            return fail(w, 36)

        # add/sub rax, rcx; jnc +2; ud2. This checks 64-bit carry/borrow.
        emit(o, w, 72)
        if op == @int.add.checked@:
            emit(o, w, 1)
        else:
            emit(o, w, 41)
        emit(o, w, 200)
        emit(o, w, 115)
        emit(o, w, 2)
        emit(o, w, 15)
        emit(o, w, 11)
    if (op == @int.add.checked@ or op == @int.mul.checked@) and (t == 3 or t == 4 or t == 10):
        # A narrow result can overflow without a 64-bit carry. Save the full
        # result, normalize rax, then require that no high bits were lost.
        emit(o, w, 72)
        emit(o, w, 137)
        emit(o, w, 193)
        normalize(o, w, t)
        emit(o, w, 72)
        emit(o, w, 57)
        emit(o, w, 200)
        emit(o, w, 116)
        emit(o, w, 2)
        emit(o, w, 15)
        emit(o, w, 11)
    normalize(o, w, t)
    return 0


def select_scalar(o:mutbuf, w:mutbuf, n:u64, a:u64, b:u64, at:u64, bt:u64, t:u64) -> u64:
    if n != 3 or at != 5 or scalar_type(bt) != 1 or t != bt or variable(w, get(w, ARGS + 16)) != bt:
        fail(w, 60)
    # Core select(cond, true_value, false_value). Full-width moves preserve
    # the already-normalized scalar slots, including u64/usize high bits.
    load_var(o, w, 2, a, 0)
    load_var(o, w, 1, b, 0)
    load_var(o, w, 0, get(w, ARGS + 16), 0)
    # test rdx, rdx; cmovne rax, rcx
    emit(o, w, 72)
    emit(o, w, 133)
    emit(o, w, 210)
    emit(o, w, 72)
    emit(o, w, 15)
    emit(o, w, 69)
    emit(o, w, 193)
    return 0

# These HIA helpers emit complete machine instructions, never host/library calls.
def bulk_range_guard(o:mutbuf, w:mutbuf, buffer:u64, offset:u64, size:u64) -> u64:
    load_var(o, w, 0, buffer, 1)
    load_var(o, w, 1, offset, 0)
    # cmp rcx,rax; jbe +2; ud2; sub rax,rcx. Offset is checked first.
    emit_bytes(o, w, 3112728000543048, 7)
    emit_bytes(o, w, 13117768, 3)
    load_var(o, w, 1, size, 0)
    # Compare against extent-offset instead of overflowing offset+count.
    emit_bytes(o, w, 3112728000543048, 7)
    return 0

def bulk_buffer(o:mutbuf, w:mutbuf, op:u64, n:u64, a:u64, b:u64, at:u64, bt:u64, t:u64) -> u64:
    loan_access(w, a)
    if at != 7 or t != 0:
        return fail(w, 61)
    c = get(w, ARGS + 16)
    d = get(w, ARGS + 24)
    e = get(w, ARGS + 32)
    if op == @buffer.fill@:
        if n != 2 or bt != 4:
            return fail(w, 61)
        load_var(o, w, 1, a, 1)
        load_var(o, w, 0, b, 0)
        load_var(o, w, 7, a, 0)
        # cld; rep stosb. Zero count performs no access.
        emit_bytes(o, w, 11203580, 3)
        return 0
    if op == @buffer.fill_range@:
        if n != 4 or bt != 2 or variable(w, c) != 2 or variable(w, d) != 4:
            return fail(w, 61)
        bulk_range_guard(o, w, a, b, c)
    else:
        if op == @buffer.move_within@:
            if n != 4 or bt != 2 or variable(w, c) != 2 or variable(w, d) != 2:
                return fail(w, 61)
            bulk_range_guard(o, w, a, b, d)
            bulk_range_guard(o, w, a, c, d)
        else:
            # Local children retain their roots; copy requires disjoint roots
            # as well as active, unsuspended source/destination capabilities.
            if bt != 6:
                return fail(w, 61)
            loan_access(w, b)
            if get(w, 264) == 1 and get(w, CAPBASE + a * 24) == get(w, CAPBASE + b * 24):
                return fail(w, 62)
            if op == @buffer.copy@:
                if n != 3 or variable(w, c) != 2:
                    return fail(w, 61)
                load_var(o, w, 1, c, 0)
                load_var(o, w, 0, a, 1)
                emit_bytes(o, w, 3112728000543048, 7)
                load_var(o, w, 0, b, 1)
                emit_bytes(o, w, 3112728000543048, 7)
            else:
                if op != @buffer.copy_range@ or n != 5 or variable(w, c) != 2 or variable(w, d) != 2 or variable(w, e) != 2:
                    return fail(w, 61)
                bulk_range_guard(o, w, a, c, e)
                bulk_range_guard(o, w, b, d, e)
    # Validate even empty ranges, then skip derived pointers when count is zero.
    emit_bytes(o, w, 567200548168, 5)
    done = get(w, 56)
    emit4(o, w, 0)
    load_var(o, w, 7, a, 0)
    if op == @buffer.fill_range@:
        load_var(o, w, 0, b, 0)
        emit_bytes(o, w, 13041992, 3)
        load_var(o, w, 0, d, 0)
        emit_bytes(o, w, 11203580, 3)
    else:
        if op == @buffer.move_within@:
            load_var(o, w, 6, a, 0)
            load_var(o, w, 0, b, 0)
            emit_bytes(o, w, 13041992, 3)
            load_var(o, w, 0, c, 0)
            emit_bytes(o, w, 12976456, 3)
            # Backward copy handles overlap and clears DF on return. The
            # forward path also explicitly clears DF. All registers volatile.
            emit_bytes(o, w, 70715390280, 5)
            emit_bytes(o, w, 1095476481352, 5)
            emit_bytes(o, w, 1095459179848, 5)
            emit_bytes(o, w, 17580931357438440445, 8)
            emit(o, w, 164)
        else:
            load_var(o, w, 6, b, 0)
            if op == @buffer.copy_range@:
                load_var(o, w, 0, c, 0)
                emit_bytes(o, w, 13041992, 3)
                load_var(o, w, 0, d, 0)
                emit_bytes(o, w, 12976456, 3)
            emit_bytes(o, w, 10810364, 3)
    if get(w, 48) == 2:
        write4(o, done, get(w, 56) - done - 4)
    return 0

# Keep dispatch outside the pre-existing operation function's SSA budget.
def operation_dispatch(o:mutbuf, w:mutbuf, op:u64, n:u64, a:u64, b:u64, at:u64, bt:u64, t:u64) -> u64:
    if op >= @buffer.fill@ and op <= @buffer.move_within@:
        return bulk_buffer(o, w, op, n, a, b, at, bt, t)
    return operation(o, w, op, n, a, b, at, bt, t)

def loan_live(w:mutbuf, v:u64) -> u64:
    if get(w, VBASE + v * 16 + 8) == get(w, 88) + 1 and resource_type(get(w, VBASE + v * 16)) == 1 and get(w, CAPBASE + v * 24 + 16) == 1:
        return 1
    return 0

def loan_access(w:mutbuf, v:u64) -> u64:
    if get(w, 264) == 0 or get(w, 280) == 0:
        return 0
    interned_count = get(w, 480)
    i = 0
    # Every live SSA identity was interned by read_value_name(). Slots
    # outside this current-function count retain type zero after table reset
    # and cannot satisfy loan_live(), including with dirty initial workspace.
    while i < interned_count:
        if loan_live(w, i) == 1 and get(w, CAPBASE + i * 24 + 8) == v + 1:
            return fail(w, 62)
        i = i + 1
    return 0

def loan_ancestor(w:mutbuf, candidate:u64, source:u64) -> u64:
    cursor = source + 1
    depth = 0
    while cursor != 0 and depth < 2048:
        if cursor == candidate + 1:
            return 1
        cursor = get(w, CAPBASE + (cursor - 1) * 24 + 8)
        depth = depth + 1
    if cursor != 0:
        fail(w, 62)
    return 0

def loan_operation(w:mutbuf, op:u64, n:u64, a:u64, at:u64, t:u64) -> u64:
    if n != 1 or at < 6 or at > 8:
        return fail(w, 62)
    if op == @loan.end@:
        if t != 0 or at > 7:
            return fail(w, 62)
        if get(w, 264) == 1:
            if get(w, CAPBASE + a * 24 + 8) == 0:
                return fail(w, 62)
            loan_access(w, a)
            put(w, CAPBASE + a * 24 + 16, 0)
            put(w, 280, get(w, 280) - 1)
        return 0
    if op == @borrow.read@:
        if t != 6:
            return fail(w, 62)
    else:
        if op != @borrow.mut@ or (at != 7 and at != 8) or t != 7:
            return fail(w, 62)
    return loan_borrow(w, a, t)

def loan_produce(w:mutbuf, v:u64, a:u64) -> u64:
    store(w, ORIGINBASE + v, byte(w, ORIGINBASE + a))
    put(w, CAPBASE + v * 24, get(w, CAPBASE + a * 24))
    put(w, CAPBASE + v * 24 + 8, a + 1)
    put(w, 280, get(w, 280) + 1)
    return 0

def loan_borrow(w:mutbuf, a:u64, t:u64) -> u64:
    if get(w, 264) == 0 or get(w, 280) == 0:
        return 0
    interned_count = get(w, 480)
    i = 0
    root = get(w, CAPBASE + a * 24)
    # Every live SSA identity was interned by read_value_name(). Slots
    # outside this current-function count retain type zero after table reset
    # and cannot satisfy loan_live(), including with dirty initial workspace.
    while i < interned_count:
        if loan_live(w, i) == 1 and get(w, CAPBASE + i * 24) == root:
            if loan_ancestor(w, i, a) == 0:
                if t == 7 or get(w, VBASE + i * 16) == 7:
                    return fail(w, 62)
        i = i + 1
    return 0

def loan_finish(w:mutbuf) -> u64:
    if get(w, 264) == 1 and (get(w, 280) != 0 or get(w, 352) != 0):
        return fail(w, 62)
    return 0

def loan_call(w:mutbuf, n:u64) -> u64:
    if get(w, 264) == 0:
        return 0
    i = 0
    j = 0
    v = 0
    other = 0
    while i < n:
        v = get(w, ARGS + i * 8)
        if resource_type(variable(w, v)) == 1:
            if owner_type(variable(w, v)) == 1:
                owner_free(w, v)
            else:
                loan_access(w, v)
            j = 0
            while j < i:
                other = get(w, ARGS + j * 8)
                if resource_type(variable(w, other)) == 1 and get(w, CAPBASE + v * 24) == get(w, CAPBASE + other * 24):
                    if variable(w, v) >= 7 or variable(w, other) >= 7:
                        return fail(w, 62)
                j = j + 1
        i = i + 1
    return 0

def loan_incoming(w:mutbuf, bb:u64, count:u64, block:u64) -> u64:
    if get(w, 432) == 1:
        put(w, 264, 0)
        return 0
    put(w, 280, 0)
    put(w, 352, 0)
    i = 0
    v = 0
    packed = 0
    root = 0
    parent = 0
    origin = 0
    if block == get(w, FBASE + get(w, 72) * FSTRIDE + 264):
        while i < 16:
            packed = 0
            if i < count and resource_type(get(w, bb + 40 + i * 16)) == 1:
                packed = i | (i << 4)
            store(w, bb + 304 + i, packed)
            origin = 0
            if i < count and (get(w, bb + 40 + i * 16) == 6 or get(w, bb + 40 + i * 16) == 7):
                origin = i + 1
            store(w, BLOCKORIGIN + get(w, 88) * 16 + i, origin)
            i = i + 1
        store(w, KBASE + get(w, 88), 1)
    put(w, 264, byte(w, KBASE + get(w, 88)))
    if get(w, 264) == 0:
        if get(w, 48) != 0:
            return fail(w, 62)
        return 0
    put(w, 272, get(w, 272) + 1)
    put(w, bb + 24, 1)
    i = 0
    while i < count:
        v = get(w, bb + 32 + i * 16)
        store(w, ORIGINBASE + v, byte(w, BLOCKORIGIN + get(w, 88) * 16 + i))
        if resource_type(get(w, bb + 40 + i * 16)) == 1:
            packed = byte(w, bb + 304 + i)
            root = packed & 15
            parent = packed >> 4
            if root >= count or parent >= count:
                return fail(w, 62)
            if resource_type(get(w, bb + 40 + root * 16)) == 0 or resource_type(get(w, bb + 40 + parent * 16)) == 0:
                return fail(w, 62)
            if owner_type(get(w, bb + 40 + i * 16)) == 1:
                if root != i or parent != i:
                    return fail(w, 62)
                put(w, 352, get(w, 352) + 1)
            put(w, CAPBASE + v * 24, get(w, bb + 32 + root * 16))
            if root == i and parent == i:
                put(w, CAPBASE + v * 24 + 8, 0)
            else:
                if parent == i:
                    return fail(w, 62)
                put(w, CAPBASE + v * 24 + 8, get(w, bb + 32 + parent * 16) + 1)
                put(w, 280, get(w, 280) + 1)
        i = i + 1
    return 0

def loan_argument(w:mutbuf, n:u64, v:u64) -> u64:
    i = 0
    while i < n:
        if get(w, ARGS + i * 8) == v:
            return i
        i = i + 1
    fail(w, 62)
    return 16

def loan_transfer(w:mutbuf, bid:u64, n:u64) -> u64:
    if get(w, 264) == 0:
        return 0
    interned_count = get(w, 480)
    i = 0
    v = 0
    root = 0
    parent = 0
    packed = 0
    origin = 0
    while i < interned_count and (get(w, 280) != 0 or get(w, 352) != 0):
        if loan_live(w, i) == 1 and (get(w, CAPBASE + i * 24 + 8) != 0 or owner_type(get(w, VBASE + i * 16)) == 1):
            loan_argument(w, n, i)
        i = i + 1
    i = 0
    while i < 16:
        packed = 0
        if i < n:
            v = get(w, ARGS + i * 8)
            if resource_type(variable(w, v)) == 1:
                root = loan_argument(w, n, get(w, CAPBASE + v * 24))
                parent = get(w, CAPBASE + v * 24 + 8)
                if parent == 0:
                    parent = i
                else:
                    parent = loan_argument(w, n, parent - 1)
                packed = root | (parent << 4)
        store(w, CAPTMP + i, packed)
        i = i + 1
    i = 0
    while i < 16:
        packed = byte(w, CAPTMP + i)
        origin = 0
        if i < n:
            origin = byte(w, ORIGINBASE + get(w, ARGS + i * 8))
        if byte(w, KBASE + bid) == 1:
            if origin != byte(w, BLOCKORIGIN + bid * 16 + i):
                return fail(w, 62)
            if packed != byte(w, BBASE + bid * BSTRIDE + 304 + i):
                return fail(w, 62)
        else:
            store(w, BBASE + bid * BSTRIDE + 304 + i, packed)
            store(w, BLOCKORIGIN + bid * 16 + i, origin)
        i = i + 1
    if byte(w, KBASE + bid) == 0:
        if get(w, 384) >= 256:
            return fail(w, 62)
        put(w, QBASE + get(w, 384) * 8, bid)
        put(w, 384, get(w, 384) + 1)
    store(w, KBASE + bid, 1)
    return 0

def owner_free(w:mutbuf, v:u64) -> u64:
    if owner_type(variable(w, v)) == 0:
        return fail(w, 62)
    if get(w, 264) == 0:
        return 0
    interned_count = get(w, 480)
    i = 0
    while i < interned_count:
        if i != v and loan_live(w, i) == 1 and get(w, CAPBASE + i * 24) == v:
            return fail(w, 62)
        i = i + 1
    return 0

def owner_produce(w:mutbuf, v:u64) -> u64:
    if owner_type(variable(w, v)) == 0:
        return fail(w, 62)
    put(w, CAPBASE + v * 24, v)
    put(w, CAPBASE + v * 24 + 8, 0)
    put(w, CAPBASE + v * 24 + 16, 1)
    put(w, 352, get(w, 352) + 1)
    return 0

def owner_consume(w:mutbuf, v:u64) -> u64:
    if get(w, 264) == 0:
        return 0
    if owner_type(variable(w, v)) == 0 or get(w, 352) == 0:
        return fail(w, 62)
    put(w, CAPBASE + v * 24 + 16, 0)
    put(w, 352, get(w, 352) - 1)
    return 0

def owner_call_consume(w:mutbuf, n:u64) -> u64:
    if get(w, 264) == 0:
        return 0
    i = 0
    v = 0
    while i < n:
        v = get(w, ARGS + i * 8)
        if owner_type(variable(w, v)) == 1:
            owner_consume(w, v)
        i = i + 1
    return 0

# Scalar codes are not an ordered prefix once u16 is admitted. Resource
# predicates stay closed so scalar words never acquire owner/loan state.
def resource_type(t:u64) -> u64:
    if t >= 6 and t <= 9:
        return 1
    return 0

def owner_type(t:u64) -> u64:
    if t == 8 or t == 9:
        return 1
    return 0
